name: National Insurance Enrolment Confirmation
summary: Confirms the insurance information stated on the letter. Fields vary by certificate type; this alone does not establish eligibility for every benefit.

guidance.primaryNextStep: Compare personal details and recorded insurance periods. If payment is requested, separately check the amount and payment details.
guidance.deadlineSummary: Monthly, on the date stated in the notice
guidance.appliesWhen: you've just enrolled in national insurance or need to confirm your coverage became active
guidance.recommendedChannel: Use your Bituach Leumi personal area first, then call the branch if any detail is wrong.
guidance.whenToContactAuthority: your name, ID number, start date, or insurance category is missing or incorrect
guidance.whatToVerify: Check your ID number, address, dates and the certificate type.

sections.explainer: Personal details: compare your name, ID number and address. Errors can complicate processing.
sections.actionRequired: If details are wrong, contact your Bituach Leumi branch.

sections.explainer: Coverage start date: check the recorded period. Eligibility conditions for individual benefits must be checked separately.
Insurance categories: the insurance or benefit types listed have their own eligibility conditions.
Monthly contribution: check the amount and payment method. Employers usually deduct contributions for salaried employees.
sections.actionRequired: Check who must pay contributions and how. If you pay directly, ask whether automatic payment is available.
sections.deadline: Monthly, on the date stated in the notice

sections.explainer: Contact details: quote the case number on the letter when contacting the branch.

sources.title: ביטוח לאומי — תקופות עבודה
sources.scope: Describes the insurance-period and employer certificate. Supports checking recorded periods; does not establish the exact fields or benefit eligibility of every insurance confirmation.

scopeTranslations.ru: Описывает справку о периодах страхования и работодателях. Помогает проверить учтённые периоды; не подтверждает точный состав полей или право на пособия для любого вида страховой справки.
scopeTranslations.he: מתאר את האישור על תקופות ביטוח ומעסיקים. מסייע בבדיקת התקופות הרשומות; אינו קובע מהם השדות המדויקים או תנאי הזכאות לקצבאות בכל סוג של אישור ביטוח.
scopeTranslations.uk: Описує довідку про періоди страхування та роботодавців. Допомагає перевірити враховані періоди; не підтверджує точний склад полів або право на допомогу для кожного виду страхової довідки.
